sources.title: User consolidation note — local cloud, assessment, corpus and review control
claims_supported: Local personal devices should be usable as compute nodes while preserving their foreground uses.
BytePort remains the application/GUI layer and lifecycle management is a core requirement.
Humans, agents and automations are first-class product users.
Assessment/scorecard work, Emergent Garden research and quota-aware review control must be consolidated.
No new review spend is desired and review quotas must be used frugally.
sources.limitations: Direct requirements and intent; not evidence that any implementation already exists.

sources.title: Master Assessment Kit — contract 1.1
claims_supported: The reusable persisted assessment object is an Assessment Dossier with generated human front doors.
Canonical dossier components separate subject, assignment, measurements, results, evidence, findings and decisions.
Applicability, execution, verdict, freshness and review disposition remain independent.
sources.limitations: Defines the assessment contract; it does not prove any repository has been assessed under it.

sources.title: Master Assessment Kit agent entrypoint
claims_supported: The workflow requires real subject/owner/mandate resolution, instrument binding, canonical results and evidence, and generated machine/human views.
A completed dossier, not a new template, is the required operational return.

sources.title: phenotype-infra ADR 0001 — hybrid compute mesh
claims_supported: An accepted older architecture already treats home hardware as part of a heterogeneous compute mesh.
The design rejects heavy orchestration for the small solo-operator topology and uses private overlay networking.
sources.limitations: Older CI-oriented architecture; does not by itself satisfy the broader local cloud-node requirement.

sources.title: phenotype-infra ADR 0003 — home desktop heavy runner
claims_supported: Prior accepted design used a home machine for self-hosted heavy work with private connectivity and foreground-use protection.
sources.limitations: Single-runner precedent; too narrow for databases, containers, VMs and lifecycle-managed local cloud workloads.

sources.title: phenotype-infra ADR 0008 — Parsec pause proposal
claims_supported: A prior proposal attempted to pause background compute during interactive use.
sources.limitations: Proposed stub and process-specific mechanism; insufficient as a general resource-reservation or QoS policy.

sources.title: ForgeCode PR 277 current reviewer activity snapshot
claims_supported: CodeAnt performed multiple incremental reviews on successive commits.
Copilot reported quota exhaustion.
CodeRabbit reported its included OSS review limit reached with a reset delay.
Automated scanners can independently hit their own limits.

sources.title: CodeRabbit plan and rate-limit documentation
claims_supported: Current Free PR review limit is documented as 3 per developer per hour; OSS can vary from 1–8 per hour.
The provider exposes quota status and reset information.
sources.limitations: Account/repository effective quotas can differ by plan, OSS classification and fair-use state; the broker must observe live state.

sources.title: CodeRabbit automatic review controls
claims_supported: Automatic reviews can be disabled and selectively re-enabled by labels, description keyword or manual review command.
Incremental auto-review and auto-pause controls are configurable.
sources.limitations: Only governs CodeRabbit; configuration still has to be applied and verified per repository.

sources.title: CodeAnt SCM/PR CLI integration
claims_supported: CodeAnt CLI can list/filter PR comments including unresolved CodeAnt comments and can resolve threads by SCM identifiers.
sources.limitations: CLI capability does not authorize automatic fixing or thread resolution without independent adjudication.

sources.title: Macroscope usage pricing and controls
claims_supported: Code Review is $0.05 per KB with a 10KB minimum and Agent has 1,000 free credits monthly.
New workspaces are advertised with $100 free usage and spend controls exist.
sources.limitations: Finite credit is not zero-cost forever. Auto-refill must remain disabled under the user no-new-spend constraint.

sources.title: Kilo free model and code review documentation
claims_supported: Kilo Code Reviewer can be configured to use hosted models marked free.
Free model availability can change and upstream providers may rate-limit them.
sources.limitations: Free model availability and quality are dynamic; "free" is not a reliability SLA.

sources.title: Kilo GitHub code review behavior
claims_supported: Kilo GitHub reviews run automatically on PR open/update/ready when enabled.
sources.limitations: Automatic triggers can consume scarce model capacity unless repository/provider settings are deliberately controlled.

sources.title: OpenAI Codex code review and plan access
claims_supported: Codex is included with ChatGPT plans and can automate GitHub code review.
Usage limits vary by plan.
sources.limitations: The user treats Codex review as shared subscription usage, so it is a scarce shared allowance rather than a free unlimited reviewer.

sources.title: OpenAI Codex GitHub review behavior
claims_supported: Codex can automatically review PRs after draft-to-ready and can be invoked with @codex review plus focused instructions.
sources.limitations: Repository trigger configuration and remaining quota must be verified live; automatic behavior is not evidence of broker control.
